name: Kouenji Joshi Soccer 3
source:
Seven years have passed since the Koenji Girls' Academy soccer team won the international tournament. Yet again, the soccer club is on the verge of being discontinued.

Harunojo Aoyama, a new teacher who has just graduated from university, happens to become the advisor of the soccer club. Will he be able to lead the team to victory?
